column4: MySQL-only by subject: builds two MySQL scratch databases to prove the snapshot now SELECTs information_schema.triggers, so there is no PostgreSQL or SQL Server arm to run. ONE, not a subtest count, because the gate (mysqlScratchDB) is called directly in the test body rather than inside a t.Run, so CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset skips the whole named test rather than leaving the parent PASS with subtests skipping -- the shape the-mysql-snapshot-sees-what-it-selects.tsv documents is the OTHER one. Measured by NAME with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset: go test ./migration/catalogdiff/ -run TestTheMySQLSnapshotSeesATrigger -count=1 -json reports exactly this one skip and no failures. This job supplies PostgreSQL only; Tier 1 Gate does not run ./migration/... at all (./engine/... only), and multi-db-ci.yml's "Test MySQL" job (multi-db/mysql) sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and runs it for real. cleat#2882.

cleat#2882: same test, same reason as the test-go/support line above -- multi-db-ci.yml's multi-db/mssql job runs ./engine/... ./migration/... with only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL set, so this MySQL-only test skips here too. No multi-db/mysql line: that job sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, so this test RUNS there instead of skipping -- same shape test-mssql-admin-db-restore-survives-the-real-finalize-workflow-status-redefinition.tsv documents for its own one-sided pairing, mirrored.
